U14 reviewed path: SSH Git to a host that is NOT a bigbud SSH target runs as fenced local Git with the user's own ~/.ssh (sanitized env, GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=ssh, BatchMode unless the user's Git config names a command, 30 s cap). Bigbud targets and unknown target sets never reach it.
U14 reviewed path: remote classification tags and the user core.sshCommand BatchMode extension for fenced third-party SSH Git; no process is started here.

W7: `ssh` is the host-kind operand ($1) of the shell-inventory script sent to the remote agent (agent transport only); it is not a process name. Direct SSH targets refuse this probe and list shells through the owner (list_terminal_shells).

W7: `"ssh"` is the ToolExecutionTransport kind label (direct SSH vs agent vs local); no process is started here. A direct SSH tool command runs only as the owner's provider workspace shell grant (toolTransport.ssh.ts).
The owner crate is the single reviewed Rust SSH owner, not a second owner.

U7 reviewed path: `gh pr checkout` transport choice. `ssh` is the remote-route kind from classifyRemoteUrl; third-party SSH hosts use the U14 fence (ordinaryGitTransport), a single bigbud-target remote uses one U15 owner upload lease with the shim pinned to its exact upload-pack command, and anything else (unknown target set, several target remotes, unsupported URLs) is refused before gh starts. No TypeScript SSH launch.

U15 owner stream bridge: GIT_SSH_COMMAND points local Git at the generated Node shim, which only pipes stdio to one private owner socket for an already-open upload/receive lease (and, for gh pr checkout, only for the pinned upload-pack command). It never launches ssh; the owner holds the only SSH session.
U15 owner stream bridge: `GIT_SSH_VARIANT: "ssh"` tells Git how to format arguments for the shim; no ssh process is started from TypeScript.
